strategy.overview: Vacation America advances through 24 locations on six routes. Complete D-R-I-V-E to light the center Super Loop, then shoot the lit loop to advance one location; lit V-A-C-A-T-I-O-N targets provide another location advance. Completing a route of three, four, or five locations lights Extra Ball and the ball-lock opportunity for two- and three-ball Multiball.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete D-R-I-V-E to light the center Super Loop, then shoot that loop to advance a location. Lit V-A-C-A-T-I-O-N targets also advance locations. Finish a route of three, four, or five locations to light Extra Ball and the locks for two- and three-ball Multiball.
strategy.summary: Advance locations by completing D-R-I-V-E and shooting the lit center Super Loop, or by spelling V-A-C-A-T-I-O-N at the lit targets. Complete a route to light Extra Ball and Lock Ball, then take the lit locks for two- and three-ball Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Super Loop
quickInfo.summary: Complete D-R-I-V-E, then shoot the lit center loop to advance a location.

quickInfo.name: VACATION
quickInfo.summary: Hit the currently lit letter targets to spell the word and advance a location.

quickInfo.name: Routes
quickInfo.summary: Complete the current three-, four-, or five-location route.

quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Finish a route to light Lock Ball, then collect the lit locks for two- and three-ball play.

steps.text: Complete D-R-I-V-E in its lane to light the center Super Loop.
Shoot the lit center Super Loop entrance to advance to the next location.
As an alternate location advance, hit the lit targets that spell V-A-C-A-T-I-O-N.
Complete the current route, then take the lit Lock Ball shots to begin the available two- or three-ball Multiball.
Work through two three-location routes, two four-location routes, and two five-location routes.
Collect the route's Extra Ball and Multiball opportunity before advancing again when those awards are safer than another letter target.
Complete M-A-P at the top and use the flipper buttons for lane change to build the playfield scoring multiplier.

machineSetup: Vacation America is a single-player home-market game with three balls per game; confirm that format before competition planning.
Check the D-R-I-V-E lane, Super Loop, every V-A-C-A-T-I-O-N target, Lock Ball devices, M-A-P lanes, and flipper lane-change switches.

cautions.issue: Multiball can use two or three balls, but its detailed Jackpot sequence is unclear.
cautions.response: Use route completion and the lit Lock Ball lamps to start Multiball, then follow the display and lamps for its Jackpot sequence.
